scope: manifests/stack.json component id (the id space manifests/evidence.json receipts name) -> the sota manifest component id for the same component, where the two spellings differ. lane_packets.py --registered-receipts attaches such a receipt to the aliased id (matched_by alias); the index build fails if an alias's two ids do not share one repository. An explicit entry is needed where a repository serves several manifest ids (nautechsystems/nautilus_trader is both nautilustrader and nautilus-ibkr-adapter): a repository match cannot tell which component a receipt exercised. pandas has no sota manifest id, so its receipts attach nowhere.
